comment: The OpenRouter model id each code-class pool model outside the openrouter provider is sent as when the AI Node's gateway routes it there (ai-node/src/config/openrouter-models.ts, resolveOpenRouterModelId). jury-run.sh unsets OPENAI_API_KEY and XAI_API_KEY, so those always go this way. The meter prices a call by the id it carries, and a batch reads each juror's answers by its panel id or this one. ai-node's openrouter-routes.test.ts holds every entry to resolveOpenRouterModelId; spend.test.js to the pools.
